memoryBuilder.verseText: God said: 'I will give you a new heart, soft and alive.'

sequence.prompt: How did God's big promise come? Put it in order.

items.label: God's people kept going their own way
The problem was hearts of stone
God's people waited a long, quiet time

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: It cannot love — it must be swapped
They were good, but the problem was inside
He will not bring it up again

application.question: God promised to change people from the inside. What would you like God to soften in you?

options.label: How hard it is to say sorry

application.followUp: You cannot make your own heart new — and God never asked you to. He promised to do it Himself. Every story so far has been walking towards the One who came to keep that promise. God gives new hearts.
